An object, an array, a function or a class in a text mustache renders as text like `[object Object]`. A mustache that is the whole value of an attribute is left alone, as it may pass a prop.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-object-in-text-mustaches": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<p>{{ name: user.name }}</p>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<p>{user.name}</p>
<Card options={{ compact: true }} />
```
